notes: T-L1 fix: T2 is no longer a closed ring. I made it tide's Harbour Line and extended it into a U. It runs from the sheet edge at (306,320) south down Harbour Road, west along Comet Row, north up Sunset Way, then west along Crown Road to the sheet edge at (-400,286). Both ends leave the sheet (N-D1), so T-L1 needs no loop. A closed running ring would need Splice to change the rule; I am not asking for that.

T-C1/T-R1: at each R 50 corner the track runs 6 m from the centreline on the outside of the turn, so the inner kerb corner is (50-18)·√2 ≈ 45 m from the arc centre, under 50, and the arc stays in street space. On Sunset Way the track moves from x -346 to x -334 between z 100 and z 180 (bend of about 8.5°, R 50 fillets, crossing the 4 m median). This puts it on the outside for the turn into Crown Road.

Reach, worked by hand (transit.reach 250): harbour-east and docks-east 44 m from x 306; rocket-west and lantern-west 86 m from x -346; lamplight-west 54 m; crown-terraces about 170 m; crescent-east 69 m. Each holds only if a stop is placed abreast of the plot.
N-C1: T2 passes under S1 at (306,0), 34 m from S1 Harbour (340,0). It meets T1 on Comet Row at (0,-726), 36 m from T1 Comet (0,-690). T2 also passes under S1 at (-340,0), where there is no station.
T2 crosses T1 at grade at (0,-726). No standard covers a flat tram crossing; flagged for Keel and Splice via Aster, not assumed fine.

T1 is unchanged. S1 trunk still ends at x 575. Stale-source conflict for Aster: notes › why (a single-track tram with no loop, a Sphere loop and a separate harbour loop) contradicts notes › concept and the current lines. I followed concept and the current lines.
